task_name: Owner Bridge JE-2026-2601 Double-Count Trap & Walgreens Link Audit

rubric.description: Reconciles JE-2026-2601 ($7,075.00) as $2,725.00 opening August Due to Owner liability plus $4,350.00 Sep 10 Sweep Protection funding (TXN-65860).
Identifies the Sep 3 ($4,000.00, TXN-65710) and Sep 9 ($350.00, TXN-65812) transfers to 5437 totaling $4,350.00 as true September owner draws.
Computes total September owner draws to 5437 as $6,850.00 once TXN-66073 ($2,500.00) is reclassed from Account 25.
Warns that adding TXN-66073 ($2,500.00) to Account 219 Due to Owner is wrong and would overstate Due to Owner at $9,575.00 instead of $7,075.00.
Traces Walgreens journal JE-2026-65696 to linked payment PAY-65697 for $60.00.
Reports that JE-2026-65696 has certification status not_certified and authorizesAccountingWrite=false.
Explains that JE-2026-2601 debits 1150040023 Owner Draw and credits 219 Due to Owner so the Sep 10 inflow is not misread as an owner draw.
Blocks autonomous live write on JE-2026-65696 / PAY-65697 until operator certification.

prompt: Perform a comprehensive Monthly Close Queue Triage & Owner Equity Bridge review using the world files (`verdant_sep_2026_uncat_and_owner_bridge.xlsx`, `walgreens_journal_link_audit.csv`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.
gold_output:
World 105 Task B  -  Owner Bridge JE-2026-2601 & Walgreens Link Audit:
1. JE-2026-2601 Composition ($7,075.00): Debits 1150040023 Owner Draw and credits 219 Due to Owner for $7,075.00, bridging $2,725.00 opening August Due to Owner liability plus $4,350.00 Sep 10 Sweep Protection funding (TXN-65860).
2. True September Owner Draws: Sep 3 ($4,000.00, TXN-65710) and Sep 9 ($350.00, TXN-65812) transfers to 5437 total $4,350.00. Including reclassed TXN-66073 ($2,500.00), total September owner draws to 5437 are $6,850.00.
3. Double-Count Guard: Adding TXN-66073 ($2,500.00) to Account 219 Due to Owner would wrongly overstate Due to Owner at $9,575.00 instead of $7,075.00.
4. Walgreens Link Audit: Journal JE-2026-65696 links to payment PAY-65697 for $60.00 with certification status not_certified and authorizesAccountingWrite=false (autonomous live write blocked).
